q: What to wear on wet floors to avoid slipping:
o: locked away, in their labelled bottles
high up, out of children's reach
e: What to wear on wet floors to avoid slipping — non-slip footwear.

q: A light to carry during a power cut:
o: high up, out of children's reach
e: A light to carry during a power cut — torch.

q: Where cleaning chemicals should be kept:
o: locked away, in their labelled bottles
high up, out of children's reach
e: Where cleaning chemicals should be kept — locked away, in their labelled bottles.

q: A sign with a red circle and a number like 50:
o: stretch the right arm out straight
e: A sign with a red circle and a number like 50 — speed limit.

q: A green traffic light means:
o: go if the way is clear
e: A green traffic light means — go if the way is clear.

q: Vehicles in India drive on the:
e: Vehicles in India drive on the — left side of the road.

q: Circular road signs usually show:
o: go if the way is clear
e: Circular road signs usually show — mandatory rules (orders).

q: An amber (yellow) traffic light means:
e: An amber (yellow) traffic light means — get ready / slow down.

q: Pedestrians should cross the road at the:
o: go if the way is clear
e: Pedestrians should cross the road at the — zebra crossing.

q: Which of these is NOT among the safe things to do?
o: keep medicines away from small children
e: wash hands with soap, wear a helmet while cycling, keep medicines away from small children are safe things to do; play on the road belongs to unsafe things to do.

q: Which of these is among the safe things to do?
o: eat food fallen on the road
lean out of a bus window
e: wear a helmet while cycling is safe things to do.

q: Which of these is among the unsafe things to do?
e: fly kites near electric wires is one of the unsafe things to do.

q: Which of these is safety gear?
e: safety goggles is safety gear.

q: Which of these is NOT safety gear?
e: gloves, safety goggles, reflective jacket are safety gear; comic book belongs to things that are NOT safety gear.

q: You see an open electric socket at home. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Keep away and tell an adult
Keep wet hands away from switches
e: 'Play near it with water' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are using the stairs at school. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Go one step at a time
e: 'Jump down many steps' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You see smoke and fire in your house. What is the right thing to do?
e: Correct: Tell an adult immediately. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You find some tablets (medicines) lying on the table. What is the right thing to do?
o: Give them to your little sister
Eat them thinking they are sweets
Take medicine only when parents or a doctor give it
e: Correct: Take medicine only when parents or a doctor give it. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You see a friend eating something they found on the ground. What is the right thing to do?
e: Correct: Tell a teacher. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You want to climb a tree. What is the right thing to do?
o: Climb a tree near electric wires
e: Correct: Ask an adult first. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Your mother is cooking in the kitchen. What is the right thing to do?
o: Keep away from knives and boiling pots
Pull the handle of a pan on the stove
e: Correct: Keep away from knives and boiling pots. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You see smoke and fire in your house. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Call 101 or 112 from a safe place
e: 'Open the cupboard to hide' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Someone touches you in a way that makes you feel uncomfortable. What is the right thing to do?
o: Stay quiet because they said so
e: Correct: Call Childline 1098. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are playing on swings and slides in the park. What is the right thing to do?
o: Walk in front of a moving swing
Climb up the slide while someone is coming down
Sit properly on the swing and hold the chains
e: Correct: Sit properly on the swing and hold the chains. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are using a pencil or pen. What is the right thing to do?
o: Use it only for writing and drawing
Run with it in your mouth
e: Correct: Use it only for writing and drawing. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are playing on swings and slides in the park. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Climb up the slide while someone is coming down
Go down the slide feet first
Sit properly on the swing and hold the chains
e: 'Climb up the slide while someone is coming down' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are at a swimming pool. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Swim only when a lifeguard or adult is watching
Stay in the shallow end if you cannot swim well
Walk slowly on the wet floor
Jump into the deep end without knowing how to swim
e: 'Jump into the deep end without knowing how to swim' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are at a swimming pool. What is the right thing to do?
o: Jump into the deep end without knowing how to swim
Walk slowly on the wet floor
e: Correct: Walk slowly on the wet floor. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are washing your hands. What is the right thing to do?
o: Dry them with a clean towel
Use a dirty cloth to dry them
e: Correct: Dry them with a clean towel. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are walking to school on a rainy day. What is the right thing to do?
o: Splash in deep water on the road
Hold an umbrella with a metal tip near wires
Walk near the edge of a drain
e: Correct: Walk on the footpath. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Someone knocks on the door while you are home alone. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Talk through the closed door or stay quiet
e: 'Say that you are alone' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You get lost in a crowded market or fair. What is the right thing to do?
o: Go home alone with a stranger
Leave the fair to look outside
Stay where you are and look for a police officer or shopkeeper
e: Correct: Stay where you are and look for a police officer or shopkeeper. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Someone knocks on the door while you are home alone. What is the right thing to do?
o: Open the door to see who it is
Talk through the closed door or stay quiet
Let them in if they say they know your parents
e: Correct: Talk through the closed door or stay quiet. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You want to cross a busy road. What is the right thing to do?
o: Cross from behind a parked bus
Cross at the zebra crossing with an adult
e: Correct: Cross at the zebra crossing with an adult. The other choices are unsafe.

q: It is Diwali and crackers are being burst. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Keep a bucket of water nearby
Burst crackers only with an adult present
e: 'Burst crackers indoors' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A new medicine bottle at home looks like a juice bottle. What is the right thing to do?
o: Hide it in your toy box
e: Correct: Never drink from unknown bottles. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You want to fly a kite. What is the right thing to do?
o: Pull a kite stuck in electric wires
Fly it in an open field
Run on the road while flying it
Fly it from the rooftop edge
e: Correct: Fly it in an open field. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A stray dog is barking at you on the street. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Do not look straight into its eyes
Stay calm and move away slowly
e: 'Tease it with food' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are at the beach with your family. What is the right thing to do?
o: Go deep into the sea alone
e: Correct: Swim only where lifeguards allow. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You want to cross a busy road. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Cross from behind a parked bus
Look right, then left, then right again before crossing
Cross at the zebra crossing with an adult
e: 'Cross from behind a parked bus' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are travelling on a two-wheeler with a parent. What is the right thing to do?
e: Correct: Hold the parent firmly. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A cow is standing in the middle of the lane. What is the right thing to do?
o: Walk around it at a safe distance
e: Correct: Walk around it at a safe distance. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Someone touches you in a way that makes you feel uncomfortable. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Tell a trusted adult like your parents or teacher
Stay quiet because they said so
e: 'Stay quiet because they said so' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You want a toy that is on a high shelf. What is the right thing to do?
o: Ask an adult to get it
e: Correct: Ask an adult to get it. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Your ball rolls onto the road. What is the right thing to do?
o: Run after it onto the road
Ask an adult to get it
e: Correct: Ask an adult to get it. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are using scissors in class. What is the right thing to do?
o: Cut your own hair in class
Pass scissors with the handle towards the other person
e: Correct: Pass scissors with the handle towards the other person. The other choices are unsafe.

q: The bathroom floor is wet. What is the right thing to do?
o: Use electrical items near the water
Tell an adult to wipe it
e: Correct: Tell an adult to wipe it. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are using the stairs at school. What is the right thing to do?
o: Run and push on the stairs
Go one step at a time
e: Correct: Go one step at a time. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are travelling in the school bus. What is the right thing to do?
o: Run behind the bus to catch it
Put your hand out of the window
Stand near the door while the bus moves
Keep your hands and head inside the window
e: Correct: Keep your hands and head inside the window. The other choices are unsafe.

q: It is Diwali and crackers are being burst. What is the right thing to do?
o: Hold a burning cracker in your hand
Burst crackers only with an adult present
Try to relight a cracker that did not burst
e: Correct: Burst crackers only with an adult present. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You see an open electric socket at home. What is the right thing to do?
o: Pull wires to see what happens
Keep wet hands away from switches
Put a pencil or hairpin inside it
e: Correct: Keep wet hands away from switches. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You find a plastic bag at home. What is the right thing to do?
o: Give it to a baby to play with
Play with it near a baby's face
e: Correct: Put it away after use. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You want to fly a kite. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Fly it in an open field
Use cotton thread, not glass-coated (manja) thread
Fly it from the rooftop edge
e: 'Fly it from the rooftop edge' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A stranger at the school gate offers you chocolates and a ride home. What is the right thing to do?
o: Tell the stranger your home address
Tell your parents or teacher at once
e: Correct: Tell your parents or teacher at once. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A stray dog is barking at you on the street. What is the right thing to do?
e: Correct: Tell an adult. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are travelling in the school bus. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Get down only when the bus stops fully
Sit in your seat and hold the rail
Keep your hands and head inside the window
e: 'Push others while getting down' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are sitting in a car. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Put your head out of the window
e: 'Put your head out of the window' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are washing your hands. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Rub hands for at least 20 seconds
Use a dirty cloth to dry them
Dry them with a clean towel
e: 'Use a dirty cloth to dry them' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are using scissors in class. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Keep the blades closed when not cutting
Pass scissors with the handle towards the other person
e: 'Point scissors at friends' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You get lost in a crowded market or fair. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Stay where you are and look for a police officer or shopkeeper
Go to the help desk or announcement booth
Go home alone with a stranger
Tell them your parent's phone number
e: 'Go home alone with a stranger' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are sitting in a car. What is the right thing to do?
o: Stand up while the car moves
Put your head out of the window
e: Correct: Wear your seat belt. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A stranger at the school gate offers you chocolates and a ride home. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Tell your parents or teacher at once
Stay with your friends and the school staff
Say no and go to your teacher or guard
e: 'Keep it a secret' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are playing near a pond in the village. What is the right thing to do?
o: Lean over the water to catch fish
Stay where an adult can see you
e: Correct: Stay where an adult can see you. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You see a puddle near a fallen wire. What is the right thing to do?
o: Poke the water with a metal rod
e: Correct: Walk around it far away. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are travelling on a two-wheeler with a parent. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
e: 'Stand on the footrest' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Your mother is cooking in the kitchen. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Stay away from the hot stove
Ask an adult before touching anything hot
Keep away from knives and boiling pots
Pull the handle of a pan on the stove
e: 'Pull the handle of a pan on the stove' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: The school nurse or sick room is for:
o: only after the bus has left and the road is clear
on the footpath, away from the road
stay with your group and teacher
first aid when you are hurt or ill
e: The school nurse or sick room is for — first aid when you are hurt or ill.

q: If you see broken glass in class, you should:
o: tell the teacher and not touch it
first aid when you are hurt or ill
e: If you see broken glass in class, you should — tell the teacher and not touch it.

q: During a drill, the class should go to the:
o: stay with your group and teacher
only after the bus has left and the road is clear
e: During a drill, the class should go to the — assembly point.

q: Waiting for the school bus, you should stand:
o: on the footpath, away from the road
tell the teacher and not touch it
e: Waiting for the school bus, you should stand — on the footpath, away from the road.

q: Getting off the bus, you should cross the road:
o: only after the bus has left and the road is clear
first aid when you are hurt or ill
e: Getting off the bus, you should cross the road — only after the bus has left and the road is clear.

q: Which of these is among safe people to ask for help when lost?
o: a person in a car asking you to come in
someone who says 'don't tell your parents'
e: a mother with children is safe people to ask for help when lost.

q: Which of these is among people you should NOT go with?
o: someone who says 'don't tell your parents'
e: someone who says 'don't tell your parents' is one of the people you should NOT go with.

q: Which of these is NOT among safe people to ask for help when lost?
o: a person in a car asking you to come in
e: a security guard, a mother with children, a police officer are safe people to ask for help when lost; a person in a car asking you to come in belongs to people you should NOT go with.
